DELETE /api/calendar/events/:id.note: Only the row's owner (user_id = caller) or an admin deletes a manual calendar row. Every other account, including a party to the owner's check-in, gets the same 404 a missing row gets and the row stays; no credentials or a disabled owner get 401.

DELETE /api/calendar/founder-checkins/:i.note: Only the founder or counterpart on the row, or an admin, cancels. Every other account gets the same 404 a missing check-in gets; the check-in and its copies are unchanged and nothing reaches the provider; no credentials or a disabled counterpart get 401.

DELETE /api/calendar/ic-meetings/:id.note: Only the organiser or an admin cancels (organizer_user_id = caller). An invited attendee gets 403 naming nothing; every non-party gets the same 404 a missing meeting gets; the meeting, its attendees and every calendar copy are unchanged and nothing reaches the provider; no credentials or a disabled party get 401.

PATCH /api/calendar/events/:id.note: Only the row's owner (user_id = caller) or an admin edits a manual calendar row. Every other account, including a party to the owner's check-in, gets the same 404 a missing row gets and the row is unchanged; no credentials or a disabled owner get 401.

PATCH /api/calendar/founder-checkins/:id.note: Only the founder or counterpart on the row, or an admin, reschedules. Every other account gets the same 404 a missing check-in gets; nothing moves, no audit row, no provider call; no credentials or a disabled counterpart get 401.

PATCH /api/calendar/ic-meetings/:id.note: Only the organiser or an admin reschedules (organizer_user_id = caller). An invited attendee gets 403 naming nothing; every non-party gets the same 404 a missing meeting gets; nothing moves, no audit row, no provider call; no credentials or a disabled party get 401.

POST /api/calendar/ic-meetings/:id/rsvp.note: Bound to the caller in SQL (meeting_id and user_id = caller): only an invited attendee answers. A non-party gets the same 404 a missing meeting gets and no RSVP changes; no credentials or a disabled attendee get 401.

POST /api/calendar/push/:kind/:source_id.note: Pushes only a session the caller's own calendar reader returns (organiser or invitee; founder or counterpart). A non-party gets the same 404 a missing session gets; no copy is written and nothing reaches the provider; no credentials or a disabled party get 401.
